content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-selling-digital-products-africa-only-real-option|COREMERCH guide to selling]] a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-8|payment]] layer is where everything breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-every-detail-you|Tron USDT]], and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-5. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

The automated delivery pipeline for digital products follows a specific sequence that eliminates every manual step. A buyer visits the storefront, selects a product, and initiates payment. The checkout displays a QR code with the exact wallet address and payment amount in their chosen cryptocurrency, converted from USD at the current exchange rate via live price feeds. The buyer sends the payment from their wallet. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain and detects the incoming transaction within seconds of broadcast. When the transaction receives sufficient confirmations on-chain, NOWPayments fires a webhook to your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script endpoint. The backend verifies the payment amount, confirms the transaction hash on the blockchain directly, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the download link to the buyer's email address.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of this infrastructure is the use of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. These tools, often used for free, provide a robust and scalable foundation for digital commerce, while NOWPayments, a zero-fee cryptocurrency payment gateway, handles secure and instant on-chain transactions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in countries where conventional payment gateways are unavailable or severely restricted, such as Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines. By providing a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can overcome the limitations of traditional platforms and focus on what matters most – creating and selling their digital products.
By choosing a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can save up to 9.5% on every sale, compared to traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are two pre-configured stacks that can be deployed in under 48 hours, providing a seamless and secure experience for digital creators. Each stack includes a comprehensive set of tools, from hosting and backend logic to order storage and file delivery, all working together in harmony to process transactions and deliver products instantly.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, eliminating the need for third-party platforms and their associated fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators looking to expand their digital commerce capabilities, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Additionally, visit Shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore the full range of products and services offered by COREMERCH.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197), download and review the 6 blueprints and 7 templates, configure and deploy the stack on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, integrate Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and configure Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my sovereign digital commerce stack?
To integrate NOWPayments, simply follow the provided documentation and configure the zero-fee cryptocurrency payment gateway with your stack, ensuring secure and instant on-chain transactions.
Can I use my existing hosting platform with the sovereign digital commerce stack?
Yes, the stack can be deployed on any hosting platform, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, providing a seamless and secure experience for digital creators.
What happens if I exceed the storage limits of Supabase or Google Sheets?

To accommodate increased storage needs, simply upgrade to a paid plan or consider using an alternative storage solution, ensuring the continued smooth operation of your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I handle customer support and inquiries with the sovereign digital commerce stack?
To ensure seamless customer support, consider integrating a customer support platform, such as Zendesk or Freshdesk, with your stack, providing a dedicated support channel for your customers.
Can I use the sovereign digital commerce stack for physical product sales?

While the stack is designed for digital products, it can be adapted for physical product sales by integrating a shipping and fulfillment platform, such as ShipStation or Fulfillment by Amazon, ensuring a seamless and efficient experience for customers.
